## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run build` and `npm run test:coverage` pass
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests, and coverage stays at or above 80%
- [ ] New user-facing text is in `en.ts` and every other language file
- [ ] Colours come from tokens, with AA contrast in all three themes (indigo, sunset, arctic)
- [ ] Works with the keyboard, under reduced motion and with the accessibility preferences
- [ ] The setup placeholders (`Jane Doe`, `your-domain.com`, `your-username`) are untouched
- [ ] README updated if setup, commands or customisation changed
